generation_stop: Natural EOS or actual model context capacity; no scientific output token or wall-time cap.
primary_comparison: ProgressiveWitness versus identical-initial-prompt VerifiedWitness, paired by checkpoint and continuation RNG. One historical development question, not six independent problems.
paired_budget_scope: Same finite verifier-access capability and max budget. Actual cost per policy measured independently. Additional budgets evaluated offline unless specifically run with live feedback.
independent_release: Require sound actual event handling and replicated net quality benefit or same quality with lower total deployment work versus the strongest equal-information baseline; qualify feasibility of new independently sourced tasks separately. No large matrix at development stage.
